insights.title: Concentration in 'discount_applied': 'false' Dominance
insights.observedFact: The top category 'false' in column 'discount_applied' represents 60% of all valid records (6 of 10 non-null rows). There are 2 distinct categories in total.
insights.hypothesis: Strong preference or volume concentration in 'false' suggests either product-market fit or an over-reliance on a single segment.
insights.recommendation: Evaluate operational dependencies on 'false'. Determine if secondary segments ('true') can be expanded through targeted campaigns.
insights.caveat: Category distribution reflects transaction frequency, which may differ from dollar-weighted revenue volume.

insights.title: Outlier Detection in 'quantity'
insights.observedFact: Column 'quantity' contains 1 outlier values (10% of records) falling outside the IQR threshold interval [-0.5, 3.5]. Minimum is 1, maximum is 4, and median is 1.5.
insights.hypothesis: Extreme values in 'quantity' could reflect high-value premium transactions, bulk institutional orders, or manual data entry anomalies.
insights.recommendation: Conduct segmentation analysis excluding these 1 extreme records to compare baseline core behavior against premium outliers.
insights.caveat: IQR boundaries assume unimodal distributions; highly multi-modal data may require domain-specific thresholds.

insights.title: Temporal Trend: INCREASING (+150.01% over period)
insights.observedFact: Activity tracked along 'transaction_date' spans 20 days (2024-01-10 to 2024-01-30) across 10 daily periods. The net period-over-period trajectory changed by 150.01% with a 'increasing' pattern. Unusual volatility was observed in periods: [2024-01-30].
insights.hypothesis: Positive growth over this window may correspond to seasonality, marketing acquisition surges, or expanding customer activity.
insights.recommendation: Forecast near-term capacity and supply chain requirements assuming continuation of current trajectory, validating against prior seasonal cycles.
insights.caveat: Evaluates aggregate volume change between start and end intervals; external seasonal factors require multi-year historical data to establish cyclicality.

insights.title: Correlation Identified: 'unit_price' vs 'quantity' (r = -0.58)
insights.observedFact: A statistically moderate negative linear association (Pearson r = -0.58, sample size n = 9) exists between 'unit_price' and 'quantity'.
insights.hypothesis: Higher values in 'unit_price' coincide with lower values in 'quantity', potentially indicating an inverse trade-off or discounting effect.
insights.recommendation: Analyze paired scatter plots and residual distributions. Prior to making operational policy changes, execute a controlled A/B test or multivariate regression to verify whether an actual causal mechanism exists.
insights.caveat: CRITICAL: Correlation does NOT demonstrate or imply causation. Unmeasured confounders or external factors may account for the relationship.
